Hi all — quick procurement notes from my side: 

1) PO requirement: For vendors provisioning services with monthly billing we prefer a PO before the first invoice. Emailed PO numbers are acceptable if they include: PO number, Redwood billing code (RB-ACCT-37), vendor legal name, and billing address. If you can send a PDF PO or fill our vendor portal form, that works too.

2) Billing address: Redwood Inference
Accounts Payable
1023 Harbor Drive
San Francisco, CA 94111

3) Invoice delivery: Please route invoices to invoices@redwood.com with the PO number in the subject line. If BoxBridge uses electronic invoicing, add our billing contact (ap-portal@redwood.com) to the vendor portal.

4) DPA workflow: DocuSign is preferred. If there are non-standard legal terms in your draft, flag them in the DocuSign comments so our legal team can triage.

Elena — if you send a DocuSign link I will confirm the PO number and notify AP to expect the first invoice upon DPA execution.
